scope: Hand-authored deterministic input and literal expected pixels for one new-UI spray tick. This fixes random/time inputs; it does not claim the Qt random generator, distribution or physical timing is identical.

expected.unchanged: Every other active pixel, both other layers, layer metadata, background, dimensions and active index remain byte-exact.
expected.history: One completed spray is one Undo/Redo; cancelling restores the source and its pre-existing Redo. No timer may draw after either finish.
